description.narrative: The development objective is to inform the Government of Saint Lucia on the viability of its geothermal resource for power generation and strengthen the enabling environment to scale-up clean energy investments with the private sector.

The development objective of the Renewable Energy Sector Development Project for Saint Lucia is to inform the Government of Saint Lucia on the viability of its geothermal resource for power generation and strengthen the enabling environment to scale-up clean energy investments with the private sector. The project comprises of two components. The first component, geothermal exploration drilling program will finance following sub-components: (i) exploration management; and (ii) exploration drilling. The second component, capacity building, technical assistance, and market engagement will finance the following sub-components: (i) project implementation support; and (ii) technical assistance, capacity building, and market engagement.

condition.narrative: FOR THE CTF GRANT AGREMEENTThe same dated covenants as for the IDA credit, except for the exclusion of Schedule 2 Section I E 1and 2 (Memorandum of Understanding) and the inclusion of the following: Schedule 2 Section I E 1 to 5 (Repayment of the CTFGrant)1. The Recipient shall, within the Maximum Recovery Period reimburse the Principal Amount Repayable, if satisfactoryevidence has been received by the World Bank during the Completion Period that: (a) the quality of the geothermal resource has beenconfirmed through the Drilling Report; (b) a valid Engagement with Private Developer(s) has been signed; and (c) a successfulCommissioning of a Power Plant has been achieved; all in form and substance satisfactory to the World Bank and as further detailedin the Operations Manual.2. The Recipient shall demonstrate its commitment, proceed with due diligence and efficiency, makereasonable efforts and act in good faith to meet the conditions described in paragraphs 1(a) through 1(c) above during theCompletion Period.3. The World Bank shall notify the Recipient on the amount of the Principal Amount Repayable (that will besubject to the completion of the conditions described in paragraphs 1(a) through 1(c) above) not later than twelve months after theClosing Date as per the final audit and as further detailed in the Operations Manual.4. If the conditions described in paragraphs1(a) through 1(c) above are met within the Completion Period:(a) the Recipient shall notify the World Bank that said conditionshave been met within 60 days after the Completion Date;(b) the World Bank shall acknowledge receipt of said notification from theRecipient within 30 days after receipt and notify the Recipient of the exact date of the Maximum Recovery Period.(i) the PaymentDates shall be March 15 and September 15 in each year, provided that the First Repayment Date shall occur up to nine months afterthe Completion Date; and(ii) the Principal Amount Repayable shall be repaid in accordance with the Repayment Schedule, as notifiedby the World Bank and based on the actual Completion Date, as per sub-paragraph (c) below; and(c) within ninety (90) days of theCompletion Date, the World Bank shall notify the Recipient to confirm the Principal Amount Repayable and the Repayment Schedulebased on the actual Completion Date and as further detailed in the Operations Manual.5. If the conditions described in paragraph1(a) through 1(c) above are not met within the Completion Period:(a) the Recipient shall notify the World Bank that saidconditions have not been met within sixty (60) days after the Completion Period; and(b) the World Bank shall acknowledge receiptof said notification from the Recipient within thirty (30) days after receipt of said notification and confirm that the PrincipalAmount Repayable is not due by the Recipient in accordance with the terms of this Agreement.
FOR THE ESMAP-FCDO GRANTThe same dated covenants as for the IDA credit, except for the exclusion of Schedule 2 Section I E 1 and2 (Memorandum of Understanding).

FOR THE IDA CREDIT; CCEFCF CONCESSIONAL LOAN; and CCEFCF GRANTThe Recipient shall carry out the Project in accordance with theImplementation Arrangements set out in Section I, Schedule 2 of the five legal agreements. The Project shall be implemented inaccordance with Operations Manual as set out in Schedule 2 Section I of the legal agreements. The Recipient shall carry out theProject in accordance with the World Bank safeguards policies.Schedule 2 Section I E 1 and 2 (Memorandum of Understanding)1. Tofacilitate the carrying out gender activities under Part 2 of the Project, the Recipient shall, no later than three (3) monthsafter the Effective date, sign and thereafter maintain a Memorandum of Understanding with SALCC to implement said gender activitiesunder Part 2 of the Project. Such Memorandum of Understanding shall include, inter alia: the Recipient's obligation to make partsof the proceeds of the Financing allocated to Category (2) available to SALCC in order to assist the Recipient in the carrying outgender activities under Part 2 of the Project in accordance with the Anti-Corruption Guidelines, the Procurement Regulations, theESMP, the RPF, the RAP, the SEP, the ESIA and the Operations Manual. 2. The Recipient shall exercise its rights or carry out itsobligations under the Memorandum of Understanding in such manner as to protect the interests of the Recipient and the Associationin order to accomplish the purposes of the Financing. Except as the Association shall otherwise agree, the Recipient shall notassign, amend, abrogate, waive, terminate or fail to enforce the Memorandum of Understanding, or any of its provisions.Schedule 2Section I F 1 to 3 (Annual Work Plans)1. Without limitation to the obligations set forth in Section I.B above, the Recipientshall, through the Project Implementation Unit, carry out the Project in accordance with Annual Work Plans to be prepared andfurnished to the Association, for its review and approval, not later than October 31 of each calendar year during theimplementation of the Project (the first such Annual Work Plan being due one month after the Effective Date), and containing allactivities proposed for inclusion in the Project for the next calendar year, including: (a) detailed timetables for the sequencingand implementation of proposed Project activities; (b) types of expenditures required for such activities and a proposed financingplan and sources of funding for such expenditures; and (c) any Operating Costs or Training that may be required under theProject.2. The Recipient shall afford the Association a reasonable opportunity to exchange views on each such proposed Annual WorkPlan; and, thereafter ensure that the Project is implemented with due diligence during said following calendar year in accordancewith such Annual Work Plan as shall have been approved by the Association.3. The Annual Work Plans may only be amended from timeto time in consultation with, and after approval of, the Association. In case of any conflict between the terms of the Annual WorkPlans and those of this Agreement, the terms of this Agreement shall prevail.Schedule 2 Section IV 1 and 2 (OtherUndertakings)1. Prior to the start of the Drilling Program, the Recipient shall: (a) publish the updated ESMP, RPF, RAP, SEP andESIA; and (b) provide satisfactory evidence indicating that it has the land rights required to carry out civil works and drillingunder Part 1.2 of the Project; all in form and substance satisfactory to the Association.
